result.title: MUON-RT Reusing the Teacher's Trajectory for Momentum-Free Muon for LLM Self-Distillation
result.summary: Self-distillation methods for large language models with an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher already retain a history of student updates. Muon nevertheless stores a separate momentum buffer, increasing persistent training memory. We propose Muon with Reused Teacher (Muon-RT), which reuses the teacher-student displacement to eliminate momentum buffers for hidden weight matrices. We show that this displacement encodes an exponentially weighted history of applied updates and smooths temporally uncorrelated noise under a local model. Muon-RT removes its radial component, normalizes it spectrally, and mixes it with the current gradient after Newton-Schulz (NS) orthogonalization. Under explicit regularity and alignment assumptions, we establish linear contraction of an expected objective-gap bound toward a residual error level. With Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Muon-RT improves average accuracy over AdamW by 2.6 points with 42% less persistent memory, and over momentum Muon by 5.4 points with 27% less persistent memory. With Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) on Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, it improves average accuracy over AdamW by 2.0 points.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Muon-RT，一种 LLM 自蒸馏优化器：用 EMA 教师在训练中与学生权重的位移充当动量缓冲的替代，去除径向分量后做谱归一化并与当前梯度混合，在 Qwen2.5-7B、Olmo-3-7B 的自蒸馏设定下报告精度提升与显存下降。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理，但「以师生位移累积的指数加权历史替代额外状态」这一做法，可供核查能否用于 latent 蒸馏训练中复用教师信号、降低状态开销；迁移可能性低，仅属方法线索。
